name: Lean.LocalContext.getFVar!

source.code:
/-- Gets the declaration for expression `e` in the local context.
If `e` is not a free variable or not present then panics. -/
def getFVar! (lctx : LocalContext) (e : Expr) : LocalDecl :=
  lctx.get! e.fvarId!
